### StatCard Displays key performance metrics, numeric values, trend indicators (+/-), icons, and contextual descriptions. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { StatCard } from "@/components/ui/statCard/statCard"; ``` #### Default Standard KPI metric summary card. ```tsx } description="Compared to $108,900.00 last month" /> ``` #### Metrics Dashboard Grid Multiple KPI cards arranged in a responsive grid layout. ```tsx
``` #### Props — StatCard Supported properties for StatCard. | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | title | ReactNode | — | Header title label of the metric card. | | value | ReactNode | — | Primary numeric value or formatted string. | | change | string | number | — | Percentage or value change badge label. | | trend | 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral' | 'neutral' | Trend indicator color & arrow direction. | | icon | ReactNode | — | Header icon graphic element. |
